# Synapgeek

> Synapgeek is an independent French mobile game studio (Synapgeek SAS, based in Frontenas, France) that designs and publishes Cerebrum, an offline puzzle games app for iPhone, iPad and Android.

Synapgeek est un studio indépendant français de jeux mobiles (Synapgeek SAS, basé à Frontenas, dans le Rhône), éditeur de Cerebrum, une application de jeux de réflexion hors ligne pour iPhone, iPad et Android.

## About Cerebrum

- Cerebrum is an offline puzzle games app for iPhone, iPad and Android, made by Synapgeek.
- Store names: "Cerebrum: Offline Puzzle Games" (US App Store) and "Cerebrum : Jeux zen sans wifi" (French App Store).
- Logic and number puzzles: Sudoku; Pandoku (a Star Battle logic puzzle: one panda per row, column and region, no two pandas touching, not even diagonally); Minesweeper; Pixel Art (nonograms, called "logimages" in French); Cross Math (a math crossword: every "word" is an equation).
- Word games: Crossword and Word Search, in French and English only.
- Path puzzles: Trace (a one-line path puzzle: draw a single path through every cell, hitting the numbers in order); Maze (guide a firefly to the exit and collect crystals); Arrow Maze (an arrow puzzle: slide each arrow off the board when its way is clear).
- Difficulty levels run from Easy to Elite, except Crossword, Word Search and Arrow Maze, which stop at Hard. Every game has a level path and an endless mode.
- One daily challenge per day for the whole app: the player picks the game and everyone gets the same grid. The app also has streaks, a monthly trophy, leagues from Bronze to Legend and avatars.
- Free with ads: a banner during play and ads between some games. Rewarded ads are always optional (gems, a hint or a second chance).
- Premium (weekly, monthly or yearly subscription) means no forced ads: it removes the banner and the ads between games, and adds infinite lives, 5 free hints a day in each game, the first mistake forgiven in every puzzle, free daily gems and double gems after every win.
- In-app purchases: gem packs, and the Movies, Cooking and Travel theme packs (themed crosswords and word searches), which are not included in Premium. No game or difficulty level is locked behind a purchase.
- Gems are the in-app currency; crystals, collected in Maze, are a different thing.
- All games, including the daily challenge and the streak, can be played offline without an internet connection; a connection is needed to sync progress, purchase, sign in, and show ads.
- Cerebrum works without creating an account (guest session); players can optionally sign in with Apple, Google, or Facebook to sync progress across devices.
- The app is available in 16 languages. Crossword and Word Search are offered in French and English only.
- Available on iPhone and iPad (iOS 17+) and on Android (Android 8.0+), portrait mode.

## Pages

- [Home (English, default)](https://synapgeek.com): Landing page for Synapgeek and Cerebrum, in English.
- [Accueil (français)](https://synapgeek.com/fr): Page d'accueil de Synapgeek et de Cerebrum, en français.
- [Cerebrum (English)](https://synapgeek.com/cerebrum): Cerebrum is an offline puzzle games app by Synapgeek for iPhone, iPad and Android: Sudoku, crosswords, word search and more classic and newer brain games, all in one app.
- [Cerebrum (français)](https://synapgeek.com/fr/cerebrum): Cerebrum est une application de jeux de réflexion hors ligne, éditée par Synapgeek pour iPhone, iPad et Android : Sudoku, Mots Croisés, Mots Mêlés et d'autres jeux, classiques ou plus récents, réunis dans une seule app.
- [Sudoku in Cerebrum (English)](https://synapgeek.com/cerebrum/sudoku): Sudoku is the classic 9×9 number puzzle: every row, column and 3×3 box must hold the digits 1 to 9 exactly once. Play it offline in Cerebrum, the puzzle games app by Synapgeek, on iPhone, iPad and Android.
- [Sudoku dans Cerebrum (français)](https://synapgeek.com/fr/cerebrum/sudoku): Le sudoku est le classique casse-tête de chiffres sur grille 9×9 : chaque ligne, colonne et carré de 3×3 contient les chiffres de 1 à 9, une fois chacun. Il se joue hors ligne dans Cerebrum, l'app de Synapgeek, sur iPhone, iPad et Android.
- [Pandoku in Cerebrum (English)](https://synapgeek.com/cerebrum/pandoku): Pandoku is a Star Battle logic puzzle: place one panda in every row, column and colored region, with no two pandas touching. Play it offline in Cerebrum, the puzzle games app by Synapgeek, on iPhone, iPad and Android.
- [Pandoku dans Cerebrum (français)](https://synapgeek.com/fr/cerebrum/pandoku): Pandoku est un puzzle de logique de type Star Battle : un panda par ligne, par colonne et par région colorée, sans que deux pandas se touchent. Il se joue hors ligne dans Cerebrum, l'app de Synapgeek, sur iPhone, iPad et Android.
- [Minesweeper in Cerebrum (English)](https://synapgeek.com/cerebrum/minesweeper): Minesweeper is the classic logic game of finding hidden mines: each number counts the mines among the eight cells around it. Play it offline in Cerebrum, the puzzle games app by Synapgeek, on iPhone, iPad and Android.
- [Démineur dans Cerebrum (français)](https://synapgeek.com/fr/cerebrum/demineur): Le démineur est le jeu de logique classique où l'on repère des mines cachées : chaque chiffre compte les mines parmi les huit cases qui l'entourent. Il se joue hors ligne dans Cerebrum, l'app de Synapgeek, sur iPhone, iPad et Android.
- [Pixel Art in Cerebrum (English)](https://synapgeek.com/cerebrum/pixel-art): Pixel Art is a game of nonograms, also known as hanjie: the numbers along the edges of the grid tell you which cells to fill in to reveal a hidden picture. Play it offline in Cerebrum, the puzzle games app by Synapgeek, on iPhone, iPad and Android.
- [Pixel Art dans Cerebrum (français)](https://synapgeek.com/fr/cerebrum/pixel-art): Pixel Art est un jeu de nonogrammes, aussi appelés logimages : les nombres en bord de grille disent quelles cases noircir pour révéler un dessin caché. Il se joue hors ligne dans Cerebrum, l'app de Synapgeek, sur iPhone, iPad et Android.
- [Crossword in Cerebrum (English)](https://synapgeek.com/cerebrum/crossword): A crossword is the classic word-grid puzzle: you solve clues to fill in answers that cross one another. Play it offline in Cerebrum, the puzzle games app by Synapgeek, on iPhone, iPad and Android.
- [Mots croisés dans Cerebrum (français)](https://synapgeek.com/fr/cerebrum/mots-croises): Les mots croisés sont le jeu de grille classique où l'on retrouve des mots à partir de leurs définitions, chaque réponse croisant les autres. Ils se jouent hors ligne dans Cerebrum, l'app de Synapgeek, sur iPhone, iPad et Android.
- [Word Search in Cerebrum (English)](https://synapgeek.com/cerebrum/word-search): A word search is the classic letter-grid puzzle where you hunt for hidden words that run in straight lines. Play it offline in Cerebrum, the puzzle games app by Synapgeek, on iPhone, iPad and Android.
- [Mots mêlés dans Cerebrum (français)](https://synapgeek.com/fr/cerebrum/mots-meles): Les mots mêlés sont le jeu de grille classique où l'on retrouve, dans un tableau de lettres, des mots cachés en ligne droite. On y joue hors ligne dans Cerebrum, l'app de Synapgeek, sur iPhone, iPad et Android.
- [Arrow Maze in Cerebrum (English)](https://synapgeek.com/cerebrum/arrow-maze): Arrow Maze is a relaxing arrow puzzle: tap a piece to slide it off the board when its way is clear, until the board is empty. Play it offline in Cerebrum, the puzzle games app by Synapgeek, on iPhone, iPad and Android.
- [Arrow Maze dans Cerebrum (français)](https://synapgeek.com/fr/cerebrum/arrow-maze): Arrow Maze est un casse-tête de flèches tout en détente : on touche une pièce pour la faire glisser hors du plateau quand sa voie est libre, jusqu'à le vider. Il se joue hors ligne dans Cerebrum, l'app de Synapgeek, sur iPhone, iPad et Android.
